'''''We Will Never Surrender''''' was a [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] [[Painting/Legends|painting]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] that depicted a [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]], two [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] and an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-Wing]].

The [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] text on the top of the painting read, "Voyage Home."

==Behind the scenes==
''We Will Never Surrender'' featured in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', as a factional item that was only available to [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]]-aligned players who had achieved the rank of [[Master Sergeant/Legends|Master Sergeant]].
